input.prompt:
Create a SINGLE 16:9 production art-direction style board for an original mobile 2D tower-defense game called FantasyTD. This is a style-lock reference, not a screenshot of another game and not a copy of any existing IP.

ART DIRECTION:
- colorful hand-painted/cartoon organic fantasy
- warm, whimsical, slightly humorous
- strong silhouette readability at small phone-screen scale
- soft painterly edges but crisp focal shapes
- natural materials: leaves, bark, roots, mushrooms, stones, grass, frost, pollen, seeds
- no sci-fi, no lasers, no reactors, no drones, no metallic/cyberpunk HUD
- orthographic/top-down 3/4 game-art presentation
- polished premium mobile-game quality, coherent palette, production-ready concept-art discipline

BOARD LAYOUT:
A. Left panel: PEDOSTRZAL / Seed Shooter plant defender. Original botanical creature with expressive eyes, leafy stem, seed-shooting organic muzzle/flower head, green palette, readable attack direction, charming but combat-ready. Show one clean hero pose and 3 small motion thumbnails: idle, recoil/shoot, recovery.
B. Center-left panel: CHOCHLIK enemy. Small mischievous forest imp/goblin-like creature, organic woodland materials, green-brown skin/clothing accents, oversized readable expression and silhouette. Show one clean hero pose plus 3 small walk-cycle poses.
C. Center-right large crop: MAP-A “Zielony Trakt”, a hand-painted green fantasy tactical road seen from above/3-4 orthographic. Winding dirt path, crooked fences, mushrooms, flowers, old stones, roots, small pond details, authored natural planting clearings integrated into terrain. No visible technical grid, no labels, no UI. The full map must feel readable on a landscape Android phone.
D. Right strip: visual bible swatches and micro-props: grass, dirt road, bark, stone, frost crystal, essence glow, mushroom, flower, thorn/root. Keep these as painted game-asset references, not text-heavy.

CONSISTENCY RULES:
- all characters and environment must clearly belong to the same world
- consistent lighting, line treatment, rendering density and saturation
- silhouettes must remain clear when downscaled
- avoid photorealism and avoid excessive detail
- no logos, no copied characters, no textual branding
- original IP only

Output should look like a professional game studio style-guide sheet intended to guide later sprite sheets, 2D skeletal animation and Unity implementation.
